full_name: Tracy K. Smith | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2026–2027 Humanities Susan S. and Kenneth L. Wallach Professor Harvard University
bio: Tracy K. Smith, a professor of English and of African and African American studies at Harvard, is a Pulitzer Prize–winning poet, memoirist, editor, translator and librettist who served as the 22nd poet laureate of the United States from 2017 to 2019.
